description.value: Full-service RV resort directly on Parksville Beach with panoramic Georgia Strait views and steps from the community park; all 84 sites are 50-amp full-hookup RV pads with no tent sites mentioned, making this a poor fit for most touring cyclists.

address.value: 161 Island Highway West, Parksville, BC V9P 2G6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an RV-only resort with 84 full-service 50amp sites, opened in 2022. All site categories described are exclusively for RVs (Class A/B/C, trailers, 5th wheels) with no mention of tent sites or hiker/biker accommodation. Laundry and showers are confirmed on the About and Sites pages. Food nearby is confirmed ('numerous restaurants, shopping' within walking distance). Reservations are confirmed via online booking. The amenities page is broken (placeholder text only), limiting evidence. Phone and website match between OSM and the site; the address has a minor word-order difference ('West Island Highway' vs 'Island Highway West').

No tent sites, hiker/biker sites, or cyclist-specific accommodation are mentioned. A touring cyclist without an RV would likely not be able to stay here; manual verification is needed to confirm whether they accommodate cyclists at all.
enrichment_extras.notes: Sister property to Pacific Shores Resort. Has a clubhouse and onsite store selling RV accessories.
